You may be more open to exploring different experiences, trying new things, and adjusting your priorities as you grow and learn. prediction.raw: 1. I think it's right that you feel entitled to have a seat on the bus because you paid for a ticket to ride. When you purchase a ticket, you're essentially buying the right to use the bus service, which includes having a place to sit. It's a reasonable expectation that you'll be able to sit down during your journey, especially if you've paid the same fare as everyone else. This sense of entitlement is based on the idea of fairness and the implicit contract between you and the bus service provider. Of course, there may be situations where giving up your seat to someone who needs it more (e.g., a pregnant person, elderly, or disabled individual) is the kind and courteous thing to do, but that's a separate issue from the basic expectation of having a seat.
